config.title: Configuration
config.instructions: Configure your Star Citizen installation path, extract base localization from Data.p4k, and import external INI files to customize your strings.
config.tools_desc: Import an external INI file to merge custom strings into your user.ini. Keys are validated against base.ini, and conflicts are resolved interactively.
config.installation_desc: Path to your Star Citizen install root (the directory containing LIVE, PTU, EPTU, HOTFIX, TECH-PREVIEW).
config.map_language_desc: Set a URL to each language's global.ini. When you switch to that language, Smart Citizen downloads it and uses it as the base strings, instead of the English Data.p4k extraction. The download is cached per language and only re-fetched when it changes. Leave a field blank to use the bundled default (if any).
config.base_localization_desc: Extract global.ini from your installed Data.p4k to get stock game strings that always match your installed version.
config.data_desc: Folder for user.ini, source cache, enhancement INIs, and backups. Move this off OneDrive-synced Documents if cache cleanup fails. The DataForge XML cache has its own path below — it’s ~1.4 GB so the default keeps it out of OneDrive automatically.
config.p4k_desc: Extract global.ini from your installed Data.p4k to get stock game strings that always match your installed version.
config.p4k_status_found_no_base: Data.p4k found  |  base.ini not yet extracted

enhancements.title: Enhancements
enhancements.desc: Optional features that extend the base localization data: category toggles for the enhancement generator, a favorites prefix for the in-game ship list, and a Tag Builder that customizes the bracketed name tags on components, missiles, and ship weapons.
enhancements.enhancements_desc: Select which enhancement categories to include. Click Apply to save changes. Enhancements are generated from your installed Data.p4k.
enhancements.cat_desc_ships: Ship performance, loadout, and crew data
enhancements.cat_desc_missions: XP rewards and blueprint drops for missions
enhancements.cat_desc_journal: Mining Compendium with crafting data per mineral
enhancements.favorites_desc: A configurable prefix is prepended to starred ship names in the generated ship list so they sort to the top of the in-game ship selection.
enhancements.tag_builder_desc: Customizes the bracketed name tags on components, missiles, and ship weapons. Changes take effect after clicking Apply Tag Changes and re-running Generate Enhancements.

tag_mapping_dialog.hint: Edit how each raw value renders at Short / Medium / Long lengths. The element’s style dropdown in the Tag Builder picks which length is used.
